# FreddyOrNot

> FreddyOrNot is a managed guest-post and link-building service. We place editorial guest posts and contextual links on real, high-authority websites with genuine organic traffic. Placements are sold by Domain Rating (DR) tier and niche, with permanent in-content dofollow links, full reporting, and white-label options for agencies. Pricing is on request.

## What we offer
- Blogger outreach: a new guest post on a relevant, real-traffic site with one in-content dofollow link.
- Niche edits: a link placed inside existing, already-ranking content.
- Editorial content: original articles written in the host site's voice.
- Sold by DR tier (DR20+, DR30+, DR40+, DR50+, DR60+) and niche; pricing on request.
- Every placement is permanent dofollow, on a traffic-verified site, with a full report (DR, organic traffic, niche).
- White-label for agencies: clean reports, reseller pricing, we stay in the background.

## Guides
- [How Much Should a Guest Post Cost in 2026](https://freddyornot.com/guides/guest-post-cost-2026.html): A data-backed breakdown of real guest-post pricing and how price scales with DR and traffic.
- [How to Avoid Harmful Guest Posts](https://freddyornot.com/guides/avoid-harmful-guest-posts.html): A practical checklist for spotting PBNs, fake DR, and toxic sites before they hurt your rankings.
